how_to_apply: Step 1: Candidates must first register themselves (as a candidate/student) on:
NAPS for ITI trades at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, or
NATS for Degree/Diploma in Engineering at https://nats.education.gov.in/
and complete/update their profile by uploading all required documents.
Step 2: After obtaining the NAPS/NATS registration/enrolment number, candidates should apply on the BEML website as follows:
Fill in the application form with the required details, including NAPS/NATS enrolment number and DBT-enabled bank account details.
Upload all required documents as specified.
Submit the application online before the last date.

Applications must be submitted online through the official BEML website only; no other mode of application will be accepted. There is no application fee, written examination, or interview process for applicants.
important_instructions: Candidates are permitted to submit only one application in a particular trade at a particular location. Candidates submitting multiple applications, or applying for more than one location/trade, will not be considered and their applications will be summarily rejected. Incomplete applications or those submitted without proper documents will be summarily rejected without any intimation. Candidates found ineligible, or providing false information/documents that are not in order, will be disqualified at any stage during the engagement process or during the period of engagement. Completion or undergoing of the apprenticeship program does not entitle the apprentice to any claim for employment with BEML. Apprentices are not allowed to enrol in or undergo any regular course/job during their apprenticeship tenure. Apprentices must maintain a weekly work-diary and submit it to the assigned reporting officer; they must also maintain confidentiality of BEML's proprietary information and adhere to the company's code of conduct. Any Intellectual Property (inventions, discoveries, or works) created by apprentices during the apprenticeship will be the property of BEML. BEML reserves the right to terminate the apprenticeship at any time for reasons including absenteeism, indiscipline, misconduct, poor performance, or violation of company policies. BEML will not entertain any claims of injury/accident, theft, or other loss during the course of apprenticeship training. Management reserves the right to amend the terms and conditions at any time; apprentices will be notified via email or official communication channels. BEML's decision will be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: BEML Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates who possess the required educational qualification and have passed their final examination within three years from the closing date of application are eligible to apply. Candidates are NOT eligible to apply in the following cases: Awaiting the results of their final examination. Not completed 17 years of age. Have undergone or are undergoing apprenticeship training in any organization for any duration. Please note: Candidates must possess a full-time regular degree/diploma qualification from a recognized institute/university. Qualifications acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education/online mode are not eligible. Candidates should have passed out not before three years from the closing date of application; the date of result declaration should be clearly mentioned in the mark sheet, or supported by a certificate from the college/university. The percentage of marks in the final examination of the qualifying degree (not semester-wise) should be mentioned in the final/consolidated mark sheet. If CGPA is mentioned, candidates must upload the Percentage Conversion Letter issued by their institute/university. The required area of specialization (major/dual, if applicable) should be mentioned in the degree/diploma certificate; if not, a supporting certificate/letter from the college/institute/university is required.

content_sections.heading: BEML Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend based on their qualification category, subject to satisfactory performance and attendance. Poor performance or unauthorised absence may result in termination from the apprenticeship program. The total tenure of apprenticeship training is one year from the date of joining, co-terminated with completion of the one-year duration; no further extension is permitted.

content_sections.heading: BEML Apprentice Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026. There is also no written examination or interview process for applicants.

content_sections.heading: BEML Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens and 17 years old or above at the time of application. Candidates who have not completed 17 years of age are not eligible to apply. No upper age limit is specified in the notification. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: BEML Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened as per eligibility criteria and prescribed qualification. A category-wise merit list will be prepared for each trade at each location, in the ratio of 1:5 times the number of training slots notified. Incomplete or ineligible applications will be summarily rejected without any intimation. Reservation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) as per the Apprentices Act 1961 and Apprenticeship Rule 1992, as amended from time to time. Shortlisted candidates will be called for document/certificate verification in order of merit, in a ratio of 1:5 with respect to the training slots notified/available. Communication will be through the candidate's registered email. No TA/DA will be paid for the document verification process. A merit list will be prepared based on candidates found suitable at document verification, in order of the percentage of marks obtained in the final qualifying examination. Offer of Engagement will be issued immediately to eligible candidates, subject to availability of training slots; remaining eligible candidates will be placed on a Reserved Waiting Panel, maintained at five times the training slot strength. The Reserved Waiting Panel will be replenished periodically in merit order as vacancies arise. Candidates will be engaged in merit order upon accepting the tri-partite apprenticeship contract on the NATS/NAPS website, and submission of a medical certificate (prescribed format) and police verification certificate.

content_sections.heading: BEML Apprentice Documents Required
content_sections.text: Apprenticeship Registration/Enrolment Number under NATS/NAPS with a 100% completed/updated profile on the portal. Scanned copies of educational certificates and mark sheets (clearly visible/readable). Proof of age (Matriculation Certificate). SC/ST/latest OBC(NCL) caste certificate as per Government of India formats (if applicable). Bank cancelled cheque/first page of passbook (DBT-enabled account details). Recent colour passport-size photograph and signature. Identity card issued by the Government of India (e.g., Aadhaar, Passport, Driving License, PAN Card, etc.). Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded bank account that is DBT-enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer, as per Government of India norms. The Name and Date of Birth of the applicant must match across the Matriculation (10th Class) Certificate, Aadhaar Card, and bank account.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Step 1: Candidates must first register themselves (as a candidate/student) on: NAPS for ITI trades at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, or NATS for Degree/Diploma in Engineering at https://nats.education.gov.in/ and complete/update their profile by uploading all required documents. Step 2: After obtaining the NAPS/NATS registration/enrolment number, candidates should apply on the BEML website as follows: Visit https://recruitment.bemlindia.in Go to Apprentices → Login/Registration Fill in the application form with the required details, including NAPS/NATS enrolment number and DBT-enabled bank account details. Upload all required documents as specified. Submit the application online before the last date. Applications must be submitted online through the official BEML website only; no other mode of application will be accepted. There is no application fee, written examination, or interview process for applicants.

faq.question: Q1. What is BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is BEML Limited's engagement of apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for one-year training at its Bangalore, Mysore, KGF, and Palakkad Complexes, under Advertisement No. L&D/01/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many training slots are available in BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1346 training slots are available - Bangalore Complex (400), Mysore Complex (227), KGF Complex (608), and Palakkad Complex (111).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online applications can be submitted from 18.08.2026 to 08.09.2026, with the registration site available till 23:00 hrs on the closing date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It varies by trade category: 4-year Engineering Graduate, 3-year General Graduate (B.Sc/B.Com/BCA/BBA), 3-year Diploma, or ITI (2 year/1 year based on trade), in the relevant discipline listed for each trade.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants must be 17 years of age or above at the time of application. No upper age limit is specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee. There is also no written examination or interview process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the stipend for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Stipend ranges from Rs. 9,600/- to Rs. 12,300/- per month depending on the qualification category — Rs. 12,300/- for Graduate (Technical) and Graduate (General), Rs. 10,900/- for Diploma, and Rs. 9,600/- or Rs. 10,560/- for ITI trades.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on NAPS (for ITI) or NATS (for Degree/Diploma), then apply on the BEML website at https://recruitment.bemlindia.in under Apprentices → Login/Registration.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is merit-based (percentage of marks in the final qualifying examination), followed by document verification in a 1:5 ratio against training slots, and Offer of Engagement to eligible candidates, with the remainder placed on a Reserved Waiting Panel.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one trade or location in BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. Candidates are permitted to submit only one application in a particular trade at a particular location. Multiple applications will be summarily rejected.
